ns2:section.sectionText: Natural resource ecosystems, particularly in the developing countries, are under severe threat. This course will expose students to real world case studies involving the management of three ecosystems: forest, aquatic, and agricultural ecosystems in a developing country, particularly the Philippines. The course will include a preparatory class during the spring semester, followed by a three-week trip between May to June (cost estimated at $3,500, scholarships may be available). The preparatory class will acquaint students with the issues, concerns, and problems pertinent these endangered natural resource ecosystems. During this time, and prior to the trip, students will be linked up with students at the University of the Philippines to initiate a collaborative project, which will be continued and completed during the trip. To learn more about this course or get permission to enroll, contact Dr. Gil Mendoza at gamendoz@illinois.edu.
